item.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who chastised him
item.description: Pete Hegseth was yelled at by a sentinel for poor decorum at Arlington National Cemetery. Now the Secretary of Defense has given him a medal.

item.title: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
